title.zh: 雇员信托基金局命令 2016 第四附表第 27 条
title.en: SEC 27 FOURTH SCHEDULE OF THE TABUNG AMANAH PEKERJA BOARD ORDER 2016

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-2-2016-SEC-27-FOURTH-SCHEDULE-OF-THE-TABUNG-AMANAH-PEKERJA-BOARD-ORDER-2016.pdf》（19 页），本次切分 27 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en:
{1) This Order may be cited as the Tabung Amanah Pekerja Board Order, 2016 and shall be deemed to have commenced on 1st April 2014.

(2) The long title of this Order is "An Order to establish and incorporate the Amanah Pekerja Board and to provide for all matters connected therewith or i\}cidental thereto".

In this Order, unless the context otherwise requires means the Tabung Amanah Pekerja Board established under 3; of Directors" means the Board of Directors referred to in section 5; means the Chairman of the Board of Directors referred to in 5(2){a); means a committee appointed under section 9{ 1 J; Chairmen" means the Deputy Chairmen of the Board of Directors to in section 5(2){b); "Fund" means the Tabung Amanah Pekerja Fund established under "Managing Director" means the Managing Director appointed under means a member of the Board of Directors referred to in means the Minister of Finance.

AMANAH PEKERJA BOARD of Board

There is hereby established a board known as the Tabung Amanah Pekerja which shall be a body corporate with perpetual succession and a common seal and shall, by that name, be capable of {a} suing and being sued; {b) acquiring, owning, holding, developing or disposing of property, both movable and immovable; and {c) doing all such other acts or things as a body corporate may lawfully do. seal

(1) The Board shall have a common seal and such seal may be changed, altered or made anew as the Board thinks fit.

(2) All deeds and other documents requiring the seal of the Board shall be sealed with the common seal of the Board.

(3) All instruments to which the common seal is affixed shall be signed by any two members generally or specially authorised by the Board for .that purpose.

(4) The Board may, by resolution or otherwise in writing, appoint an officer of the Board or any other person either generally or in any particular case to or sign on behalf of the Board any agreement or other instrument not seal in relation to any matter within the powers of the Board.

(5) All courts, judges and persons acting judicially shall take judicial notice of the common seal of the Board affixed to any document and shall presume that it was duly affixed. of Directors

(1) There shall be a Board of Directors which shall be responsible for the policy and general administration of the affairs and business of the Board.

(2) The Board of Directors shall consist of the following members (a} a Chairman; {b) not more than two Deputy Chairmen; (cJ such number of other directors, of whom not less than five shall be representatives of the Government, as His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan may appoint.

(3) the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan shall appoint one of the directors to be the Managing Director.

(4) The First Schedule shall have effect with respect to the Board, its and proceedings. Director

( 1) The Managing Director shall be entrusted with the day to day administration of the Board and the Fund, preparation of programmes, schemes the consideration of the Board and the implementation of decisions of the Board.

(2) The Managing Director shall be an employee of the Board on such and conditions of service as His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan may decide. · (3l The Managing Director shall be answerable to the Board of Directors for his acts and decisions. of Minister

(1) The Minister may give the Board such directions in writing, not with the provisions of this Order, as he thinks fit, as to exercise of any power or the performance of any functions conferred or imposed on it by this and the Board shall give effect to any such direction.

(2) The Board shall furnish the Minister with such information with respect property, the exercise of its powers and performance of its functions as he may require. of powers

( 1) The Board of Directors may, in respect of a specified matter or class of in writing, delegate to any person or committee of the Board of Directors the exercise of any power or the performance of any function conferred or on it by this Order, except for the power of delegation conferred by this

(2) A delegation under subsection (1) may be(a) subject to such conditions as may be determined by the Board of the instrument of delegation; and

(b) revoked or varied by a subsequent order made in the same manner.

(3) The Board of Directors may continue to exercise any power and any function conferred or imposed on it by this Order notwithstanding the delegation by it of such power or function.

(1) The Board of Directors may, in its discretion, appoint committees of persons who are members or otherwise, for purposes which, in the opinion of the Board of Directors, would be better regulated and managed by such committees.

(2) The Board of Directors may define or vary the terms of reference of the

(3) Subject to this Order and to the control of the Board of Directors, each may regulate its procedure in such manner as the committee thinks fit. of staff

The Board may appoint and employ for such terms of office and on such of service as the Board may determine such other officers, employees and consultants as may be necessary for the effective performance of its

AND POWERS of Fund

For the purposes of this Order, there shall be established a fund known as Amanah Pekerja Fund into which shall be paid all contributions to the trusts established under the written laws set out in the Second Schedule and out of which shall be met all payments authorised to be paid under those written laws.

(1) The Board shall be the trustee of the Fund and all monies of the Fund may be(a) deposited in a bank or banks approved by the Board;

(b) invested in any of the investments authorised by the Government for the investment of trust money and the Board shall have power to convert the same into cash; or {cj used for the purchase of any property and for the construction of for the purposes of the Board and to let the buildings or part for the purposes of deriving income therefrom and the Board may dispose of all or any part of those property and buildings.

(2) The Board shall be charged with the general administration of the laws set out in the Second Schedule and the exercise of the functions and imposed on the Board by those written laws.

(3) The Board may authorise any person to assist the Board in the exercise of its functions and duties under the written laws set out in the Second Schedule, generally or in a particular case. of Board

( 1) to this Order, the Board may carry on such activities as appear to the Board to be advantageous, necessary or convenient for it to carry on, for or in connection with, the discharge of its functions under this Order.

(2) The Board shall, in addition to its powers and functions set out in this exercise all the powers conferred or imposed on the Board under the laws set out in the Second Schedule.

PROVISIONS
The financial year of the Fund shall be determined by the Board. and financial statements

(1) The Board shall keep proper accounts and records of its transactions and affairs and shall do all things necessary to ensure that all payments out of its are correctly made and properly authorised and that adequate control is over the assets of, or in the custody of, the Board and over the expenditure incurred by it.

(2) The Board shall, as soon as practicable after the close of each financial year, cause financial statements in respect of that year to be prepared and to the auditor of the Board.
All expenses incurred by the Board including the cost of auditing the of the trusts established under the written laws set out in the Second shall be defrayed out of the monies of the Fund.

( 1) The auditor or any person authorised by him shall be entitled at all time to full and free access to all accounting and other records relating, directly or indirectly, to the financial transactions of the Board.

(2) The auditor or a person authorised by him may make copies of, or make extracts from, any such accounting and other records.

(3) The auditor or any person authorised by him may require any person to him with such information which that person possesses or has access to as the auditor or any duly authorised person considers necessary for the purposes of the functions of the auditor under this Order.

The Board shall, as soon as practicable after the end of each financial year, to the Minister an annual report on the activities of the Board during the financial year, and the Minister shall cause a copy of every such annual to be presented to His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan.

PARTV from personal liability

No suit or other legal proceedings shall lie against any member, officer or of the Board or any other person acting under the direction of the Board is done in good faith or intended to be done in execution or purported execution of this Order or of the written laws set out in the Second Schedule.
All members, officers and employees of the Board shall be deemed to be servants for the purposes of the Penal Code !Chapter 22). of Schedules
The Minister may, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang by order published in the Gazette, amend the Schedules.

(1) The Minister may, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and make regulations which are necessary or expedient for giving and carrying out the provisions of this Order, including any other thing to be or which may be prescribed under this Order, and for the due thereof.

(2) Such regulations may include such incidental, consequential and supplementary provisions as the Minister considers necessary or expedient. of functions, property etc.
The provisions of the Third Schedule shall have effect for the purpose of the to the Board of functions, property and for other transitional purposes the Third Schedule.

On the date of commencement of this Order {a} the Lembaga Tabung Amanah Pekerja established under the Amanah Pekerja Act (Chapter 167) shall be known as the Tabung Pekerja Board established under section 3;

(b) the Tabung Amanah Pekerja established under the Tabung Amanah Act (Chapter 167) shall be known as the Tabung Amanah Pekerja Fund established under section 11.

(1) The Managing Director appointed under section 3A of the Tabung Pekerja Act (Chapter 167] immediately before the commencement of this shall be deemed for the purposes of this Order to have been appointed as the Managing Director on the commencement of this Order.

(2) The members of the Lembaga Tabung Amanah Pekerja appointed under 4(2) of the Tabung Amanah Pekerja Act (Chapter 167) immediately before the commencement of this Order shall be deemed for the purposes of this Order to have been appointed to be members of the Tabung Amanah Pekerja Board on the commencement of this Order. Consequential and related amendments to other written laws

The provisions of the other written laws specified in the first column of the Schedule are amended in the manner set out in second column thereof.
